caseName: Bakery & Pastry Drivers & Helpers Local 802 v. Wohl
caseNameFull: Bakery & Pastry Drivers & Helpers Local 802 of the International Brotherhood of Teamsters v. Wohl
attorneys: American Federation of Labor y. Swing, 312 U. S. 321. Mr. Edward C. Maguire for petitioners. Hyman Wohl and Louis Platzman, pro se.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for rehearing is granted. The order denying certiorari, post, p. 572, is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is reversed.
